ae2.configuration.battery.chargerChargeR: The chargers charging rate factor, which is applied to the charged items charge rate. 2 means it charges everything twice as fast. 0.5 half as fast.

ae2.configuration.general.channels.toolt: Changes the channel capacity that cables provide in AE2.
ae2.configuration.general.matterCannonBl: Enables the ability of the Matter Cannon to break blocks.
ae2.configuration.general.spatialAnchorE: Whether Spatial Anchors should force random chunk ticks and entity spawning.
ae2.configuration.general.tinyTntBlockDa: Enables the ability of Tiny TNT to break blocks.
ae2.configuration.logging.chunkLoggerTra: Enable stack trace logging for the chunk loading debug command
ae2.configuration.powerRatios.crystalRes: How much energy a crystal resonance generator generates per tick.

ae2.configuration.powerRatios.p2pTunnelT: The cost to transport items/fluids/etc. through P2P tunnels, expressed in AE energy per equivalent I/O bus operation for the transported object type (i.e. items=per 1 item, fluids=per 125mb).
